title: 第015章 第一第016章 许主任的小本本
lines: 喜欢上了这一套坑题，苏恒稳定维持着自己的答题节奏，对外界观众们的呼声或教授点评毫不在意，几分钟后剩下9道判断题也轻松解决，全对！
满分100分的理论知识竞赛已经拿下50分，苏恒的目光也落在了第一道大型问答题上面。
“第31题，请从学术角度验证化血木改良品种化灵木的合理性。”
苏恒再次笑了，这一道题不愧是大题，牵扯的知识点简直吓死人。
灵木系的灵木师们被无数修炼者尊重，不只是会种田，培育灵植，其主要能力之一，灵植品种改良也是很庞大复杂的学问。
如上个地球，那位培育出杂交水稻使全人类再不用为饥荒发愁的袁教授，不就是从其他水稻一步步改良，才孕育出杂交水稻的么？
化血木原本是一种洗涤人类血液，使各式各样血液疾病无法作怪的医疗性灵植，但在几十年前有位灵植改良学大犇，目前也是大明皇家科学院的大学士之一，卢见兴大学士，生生把这医疗性灵植，改良品种融合其他灵植的能力，培育出了新型灵植化灵木，化灵木，其主要功效是提升天赋，能把无法修炼的普通人，提升为万里挑一级别的木系天才。
就算那是几十年前的事，卢大学士改良过程牵扯到的知识面，运算公式等等，你都可以从网上查到，但普通人没事的时候，谁会去查这玩意啊。
这就像地球上，有人设计研究出了智能手机，无数人都在使用，可智能手机到底是如何从无到有制造出来的？牵扯到了多少高科技知识？哪怕是专业对口的学生，大一考场就要你把这一切知识罗列出来，论证一下？
“有难度，我喜欢！”
兴奋的搓了搓手，苏恒脑海中闪过一道道运算知识，一个个知识点，足足思考了两三分钟才开始答题。
两个多小时后，等苏恒答完最后一题，随着计算结束提交答案，整个大礼堂大屏幕上也随之更新变化。
第一名，苏恒，100分，第35题回答正确无遗漏。
第二名，王会，89分，第34题回答正确，遗漏了波尔定理扣一分。
第三名，于飞煌，88分，第34题回答正确。
第四名，李亚琳，87分，第34题回答正确，遗漏了波尔定理口一分，遗漏朱家辉先贤提出的光泛波动定理扣二分。
这一刻，苏恒已拿下了理论知识竞赛第一名，实打实的及时更新成绩，让整个大礼堂都陷入了莫名的震撼中。
王会等人还因为沉浸于最后一题而思考计算，没有发现苏恒的分数变化，大礼堂一两千观众包括两个教授，还有苏恒的辅导员郭展鹏，却都第一时间看到了！
死寂，沉默！
足足一分钟后一个女生才站起身子，欢呼着大叫，“苏恒拿了第一名，啊，我男神拿了第一名，满分100分！”
这是曾在图书馆用考研题目撩过苏恒的王媛媛，随着她的大叫，大礼堂才活了过来，全场沸腾。
“不可思议，苏恒拿了第一？苏恒竟然能考第一？”
“这不科学，他怎么能拿第一？”
“太震惊了，我男神考了第一？简直不敢相信，他的实力怎么也这么强大？又帅又有才华？我要死了！”
content_en:
Falling in love with this set of tricky questions, Su Heng steadily maintained his own pace of answering questions, paying no attention to the voices of the outside audience or the professor's comments. After a few minutes, he easily solved the remaining 9 true-false questions, all correct!
The theoretical knowledge competition with a full score of 100 points had already scored 50 points, and Su Heng's eyes fell on the first large-scale question and answer question.
"Question 31, please verify the rationality of the improved variety of Hualingmu from an academic perspective."
Su Heng smiled again. This question was indeed a big question, and the knowledge points involved were simply terrifying.
The spiritual wood masters of the spiritual tree department are respected by countless practitioners. Not only can they farm and cultivate spiritual plants, one of their main abilities is the improvement of spiritual plant varieties, which is also a very complex knowledge.
Just like last time on earth, Professor Yuan, who cultivated hybrid rice so that all mankind would no longer have to worry about famine, didn't he develop hybrid rice by improving it step by step from other rice?
Hua Xue Mu was originally a medical spiritual plant that cleanses human blood and prevents various blood diseases. However, decades ago, a spiritual plant reformer, Lu Jianxing, a great scholar who is currently one of the bachelors of the Royal Academy of Sciences of the Ming Dynasty, took this medical spiritual plant, improved the species, and combined the abilities of other spiritual plants to create a new type of spiritual plant Hua Ling Mu. Hua Ling Mu's main function is to enhance talents, and it can upgrade ordinary people who cannot practice to a level one wood genius.
Even if it was decades ago, you can check the knowledge, calculation formulas, etc. involved in the improvement process of University Scholar Lu on the Internet, but when ordinary people are fine, who would check this stuff.
It's like someone on earth has designed and developed a smartphone, and countless people are using it, but how are smartphones made from scratch? How much high-tech knowledge is involved? Even if you are a student in your major, the freshman exam room requires you to list all this knowledge and demonstrate it?
"It's difficult, I like it!"
Rubbing his hands together excitedly, Su Heng's brain flashed with mathematical knowledge, one knowledge point after another. He thought about it for two or three minutes before starting to answer the question.
………………
More than two hours later, when Su Heng finished answering the last question and submitted the answer as the calculation ended, the big screen in the entire auditorium also updated and changed.
The first place, Su Heng, scored 100 points and answered question 35 correctly.
Second place, Wang Hui, scored 89 points. Question 34 was answered correctly, and one point was deducted for missing Bohr's theorem.
The third place, Yu Feihuang, scored 88 points and answered question 34 correctly.
Fourth place, Li Yalin, scored 87 points. She answered question 34 correctly, missing one point for Bohr's theorem, and deducted two points for missing the optical general wave theorem proposed by Zhu Jiahui.
…………
At this moment, Su Heng had won the first place in the theoretical knowledge competition, and the real results were updated in a timely manner, which made the entire auditorium feel inexplicably shocked.
Wang Hui and others were still immersed in thinking about the last question and did not notice the change in Su Heng's score. The one or two thousand audience in the auditorium, including two professors and Su Heng's counselor Guo Zhanpeng, all saw it immediately!
Dead silence, silence!
After a full minute, a girl stood up, cheered and shouted, "Su Heng won first place, ah, my male idol won first place, with a perfect score of 100 points!"
This was Wang Yuanyuan who once teased Su Heng with postgraduate entrance examination questions in the library. As she shouted, the auditorium came to life and the whole place was excited.
"It's unbelievable. Su Heng got first place? Su Heng actually got the first place in the exam?"
"This is unscientific, how can he get first place?"
"I'm so shocked. My male idol got first place in the exam? I can't believe it. How can he be so strong? So handsome and talented? I'm going to die!"
